TEMPEST, Pierce (1653–1717); after Marcellus Lauron the Elder (1653–1702)

The Cryes of the City of London

Folio (317 x 202mm). 65 engraved plates (missing pls. 17, 19, 21, 30, 42, 44, 45, 57 and 59, toned, spotting, creases, occasional stains). BOUCHARDON, Edmé (1698–1762). 
Études prises dans le bas Peuple où les Cris de Paris
. Paris: E. Fessard, 1737–1746.
Quarto (351 x 260mm). 60 engraved plates (toned, light to moderate soiling, few marginal dampstains). Modern half red morocco and marbled paper, spine lettered in gold, marbled endleaves (joints cracked, edged rubbed, corners bumped, scratches). 
Provenance
: [Henry] (18th/19th-century bookplate with HENRY cypher, a basket and the motto "Les montre mais ne les prete") – Hubert Heilbronn (label)
Sold as a group, not subject to return.
